how_long_does_a_typical: How long does a typical project take?
project_timelines_vary_based_on: Project timelines vary based on complexity and scope. Simple websites take 2-4 weeks, while complex applications can take 3-6 months. We provide detailed timelines during the initial consultation.
do_you_provide_ongoing_support: Do you provide ongoing support after project completion?
yes_we_offer_maintenance_and: Yes. We offer maintenance and support after launch, including regular updates, security patches and performance monitoring, agreed with you as part of the project.
what_technologies_do_you_specialize: What technologies do you specialize in?
we_specialize_in_modern_web: We specialize in modern web technologies including React, Next.js, Node.js, Python, and cloud platforms like AWS. We also work with mobile technologies like React Native and Flutter.
how_do_you_ensure_project: How do you ensure project quality?
we_follow_industry_best_practices: We follow industry best practices, test thoroughly, review code and keep you involved with regular demos, so problems are caught early rather than after launch.
can_you_work_with_our: Can you work with our existing systems?
absolutely_we_integrate_with_existing: Absolutely. We integrate with existing systems and can work with legacy technologies while modernizing your infrastructure, connecting them through APIs where possible.
we_follow_an_agile_development: We follow an agile development methodology with regular sprints, client feedback loops, and iterative improvements. Our process includes planning, design, development, testing, and deployment phases.
find_answers_to_the_most: Find answers to the most commonly asked questions about our services and process.
